sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL has no approval for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) on BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR. Only SUP-B holds one. The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored the company status only. It did not approve any part, so 'Quality approved Chisone' does not release BR-220.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

An approval for one part does not
extend to another part, even if made of the same material.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) and 90 days' notice for a change of source. No Aurelia approval exists. DEV-127 was rejected, and the Aurelia notification has not been made.

sources.quote: cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-220 is made of EN AW-6082-T6. The issue is still open, and the re-audit does not close it.

sources.quote: Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.
SC-BR220-YS,BR-220,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250
Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: The drawing in force requires 6082-T6 with a yield of at least 250 MPa. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. T5 has a typical yield of 230 MPa, which is below the 250 MPa special characteristic. The phone claim of 'the same alloy as BR-310' ignores the temper difference (BR-310 is 6082-T5).

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: Chisone has 3.1 certificates only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, and none for the drawing material 6082-T6. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must answer.
